purpose: X-4's named next step - analyze marker-scoped kernel/API/role owners - so the decode rows parked 'after X-4' have a device split to rank against.
limits: Profiled capture: the wall and per-kernel times are diagnostic, not a performance measurement. One case (code-p4096), one live count (4097), one model, one host, one execution profile. Role attribution depends on the innermost-window join; kernels launched outside any role range are reported as unattributed rather than assigned.
